segments.text: [excited] You filmed a great clip. Then you opened the editor, and *two hours* disappeared.
Here's the new way. Send the raw clip in a chat. *That's it.*
Claude transcribes every word, cuts the *dead air*, and zooms in right when you hit the point.
Captions land on each word. Logos pop when you say them. And the music actually works on a *phone speaker*.
No timeline. No CapCut. No laptop. [playfully] Comment *EDIT* and I'll show you the whole setup.
